title: Monopoly
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Heroes of the Realm characters)

paragraphs.text: Monopoly is a multiplayer economics-themed board game, first published by Parker Brothers in 1935. Parker Brothers was eventually absorbed into Hasbro in 1991.

In the game, players roll two standard dice to move their token clockwise around the game board, buying and trading properties and railroads, and developing them with houses and hotels. Players collect rent from their opponents and aim to drive them into bankruptcy. Money can also be gained or lost through Chance and Community Chest cards and tax squares. Players receive a salary every time they pass "Go" and can end up in jail, from which they cannot move until they have met one of three conditions. House rules, hundreds of different editions, many spin-offs, and related media exist.
Monopoly Go! is a single-player mobile video game that mixes the aesthetics of classic Monopoly with a mobile gaming loop. It was developed and published by Scopely in 2023.
Magic: The Gathering and the Monopoly franchise have featured several cross-overs.
In 2017, the Unstable set featured the card GO TO JAIL , which is direct reference to Monopoly . The all-caps name is a nod to how the GET OUT OF JAIL card is written.

In 2023, Hasbro celebrated its 100th anniversary with a limited edition Monopoly set. The custom-illustrated game board of the Hasbro 100th Anniversary Edition highlighted 90 of Hasbro's most acclaimed brands, including Transformers , Peppa Pig , My Little Pony , NERF and Magic: The Gathering .

In 2026, the Hasbro Monopoly Go! team received a Heroes of the Realm card, honoring their work that had a major impact on the business. The card Mr. Monopoly, On the Go features Mr. Monopoly , the mascot of the Monopoly game.
